title: [29.x][All-e][FTE][SaaS] Cannot Rename User Due to Financial Report Audit Log Permissions
summary: User Management now updates Financial Report Audit Log entries when a user is renamed, and the required permissions have been added to allow the renaming operation to succeed.
key_points: Financial Report Audit Log table is now included in the user-renaming logic
Required modify and rename permissions were granted for the Financial Report Audit Log
Audit log entries are updated to reflect the new user name when a user is renamed
Both RU and W1 layers were updated with the fix
quote: Added the table to the user-renaming handler and granted the required modify/rename permissions.
